messages.subject: Possible bug in the new Distance 5.0?
parts:
All,
I have recently upgraded from the Beta version to the final product
for Distance 5.0. The problem I am having is that analyses will not run now.
the problem VB identified is titled "Object variable or with block variable not
set." Any ideas? Also, as I am nearing completion of my analysis, does anyone
know where I could acquire an old copy of the Beta version, just so I can
finish up??


Thanks for any ideas,


Brendan Hurley
Master of Environmental Management candidate 2007
Nicholas School of the Environment
Duke University
Durham, NC
